input: B=B_u du+B_v dv with fixed flat diagonal connections A9 and A3
prerequisites: B has at most a logarithmic pole along q
flatness_consequence: d_q R+A9|q R-R A3|q=0 along tangent directions of q
regular_triangular_gauge: B_mu'=B_mu+partial_mu h+A9_mu h-h A3_mu with h regular at q
gauge_invariant: R is unchanged by every regular triangular gauge

outcomes.R_nonzero: q is intrinsic logarithmic support of the marked extension class
outcomes.R_zero: q is absent from the logarithmic extension residue
outcomes.normality_failure: the candidate is not a logarithmic connection pole in the frozen lattice
outcomes.higher_pole: irregular singularity; requires a separately justified lattice change

post_residue_typing: compute R_inf composed with R to locate algebraic-kernel versus elliptic image
